backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing contact submission, appointment requests, domain draft management, user profiles, and access control with admin-only operations and decommission mode toggle.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: preserving the 'Doctor Suites' section in DoctorsPage and adding comprehensive About section content describing Mahalaxmi Health Care's occupational health services.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and styling, describing the hospital website's structure with 24/7 emergency services, accessibility features, and professional blue color scheme.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode color variables for the design system, using grayscale values for backgrounds, foregrounds, and UI elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO meta tags, Open Graph and Twitter Card tags, favicon links, and canonical URL for Mahalaxmi Health Care website.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt file allowing all crawlers to access all content and specifying sitemap location at mahalaxmi-health-care.icp.page.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing six main pages (home, about, services, doctor-suites, contact, appointments) with priorities and change frequencies for SEO.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component using TanStack Router to define routes for all pages (home, about, services, doctor-suites, contact, appointments, domain-draft, decommissioned, 404) wrapped in SiteLayout.
frontend/src/components/forms/Appointmen: Validated appointment request form with accessibility features (ARIA labels, required indicators), department/service selection including diagnostic services, inline validation, loading states, and success/error feedback using React Query mutation.
frontend/src/components/forms/ContactFor: React form component for submitting contact inquiries with validation, loading states, success/error alerts, and fields for name, contact info, subject, and message.
Reusable hero section component with configurable variants (default, gradient, pattern), supporting title, subtitle, badge, and children with optional background pattern image.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageHeroI: Image component for hero sections with error handling, cache-busting for generated assets, and fallback UI with refresh instructions when images fail to load.
frontend/src/components/layout/Section.t: Simple wrapper component for page sections with configurable background variants (default or muted) and consistent padding.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Site footer displaying hospital branding, contact information, hours, navigation links, and build version with logo error handling.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Sticky site header with emergency contact bar, hospital branding, responsive navigation menu, and Google search link.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Main layout wrapper component that combines SiteHeader, SiteFooter, SeoManager, and provides skip-to-content accessibility link.
frontend/src/components/seo/Organization: Component that renders JSON-LD structured data for MedicalOrganization schema to help search engines understand the business entity.
frontend/src/components/seo/SeoManager.t: Dynamically updates document head tags (title, meta description, canonical URL, Open Graph, Twitter Card, Google verification) based on current route.
frontend/src/config/branding.ts: Centralized configuration for hospital name constant and helper function to compose page titles consistently.
frontend/src/config/buildInfo.ts: Provides build ID and version utilities for cache-busting and version display, using VITE_BUILD_ID environment variable.
frontend/src/config/contactDetails.ts: Centralized contact information configuration including phone, email, address, hours, and helper functions for emergency and main phone tel links.
frontend/src/config/seo.ts: Defines SEO configuration including default meta tags, route-specific titles/descriptions, and helper functions for generating page metadata and canonical URLs for the hospital website.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, automatically reinitializing when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDomainDraft.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving domain draft content via the backend actor, with automatic cache invalidation on updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication provider and hook for managing user login/logout state, identity persistence, and authentication status throughout the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitAppointmentR: React Query mutation hook for submitting appointment requests to the backend with error normalization and handling for service unavailability.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitContact.ts: React Query mutation hook for submitting contact form data to the backend with error handling and user-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a professional hospital color palette (blue primary, teal secondary, medical red) for both light and dark modes, plus accessibility enhancements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page component showcasing hospital information including occupational health care division, comprehensive services, mission/vision/values, and key differentiators with icons and cards.
frontend/src/pages/AppointmentRequestPag: Displays an appointment booking page with a hero section, consultation room images, a three-step process explanation, and an embedded appointment request form.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Renders a contact page with hero image, reception photo, contact information cards (phone, email, location, hours), and a contact form.
frontend/src/pages/DecommissionedPage.ts: Shows a maintenance notice page indicating a service is temporarily unavailable, with hero images and an alert card.
frontend/src/pages/DoctorsPage.tsx: Presents a doctors page with team photos and a CTA section with buttons to book appointments or contact the clinic.
frontend/src/pages/DomainDraftPage.tsx: Provides an authenticated admin page for managing domain configuration drafts with save/load functionality and timestamp display.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page featuring a hero section with CTA buttons, stats cards, services grid, emergency contact banner, and trust indicators with organization JSON-LD schema.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: 404 error page with hero illustration, navigation help imagery, and a button to return to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: React component displaying a comprehensive list of medical services offered by Mahalaxmi Health Care, including emergency services, specialties (cardiology, pediatrics, orthopedics, etc.), and support services (lab, pharmacy, ambulance), with a hero section and call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/utils/generatedAssets.ts: Utility functions to identify generated assets and add cache-busting version parameters to their URLs using the build ID.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, container settings, spacing, shadows, and typography plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting Mahalaxmi Health Care website features, known issues (Doctor Suites title visibility), and pending feature requests to remove Doctor Suites title and add comprehensive About section content.
